content:
The first release candidate v4.4.0-rc1 for the v4.4.0 release of Lean is available now.

The release brings:

  • import auto-completion
  • declaration renaming in VSCode
  • per-package server options (you can jump to definition from Mathlib to Std again!)
  • automatic guessing of lexicographic orders for well-founded recursion

Std / Aesop / Mathlib have moved their development branches to v4.4.0-rc1, and lean4checker and the repl are available, too, so please go try out the new goodies!

This is a release candidate, so please expect some rough edges. Please report any issues you find! If anyone finds anything that is a regression relative to v4.3.0, we will likely make a new release candidate. Otherwise, we hope for this to become v4.4.0 at the end of December.
